scientific_scope_status: In the declared finite closed Na/K/Cl/water model with an added uncalibrated outward-Na photopump and ATPase off during light, passive K/Cl stationarity forces Vm=EK=ECl and reduces stationary composition to a scalar volume root. Gross productive photon turnover is charged separately from net stored ion/capacitor energy. The source reportsImax=150pA+NaV suppression for200s returning to its healthy basin after an1800s ordinary-ATPase handoff, whileImax=100pA for600s stores more total gradient energy yet relapses. The numerical comparison is a reported model discriminator, not an accepted tissue/optical-advantage result.
